name: Sun Ray on the action bar is saved as Sunflare (#5469)
contract: The Sun Ray buff 803238 is cast on the Sun Cleric by Sunflare or Sunrise procs (AscensionSunClericAbilities.cpp:193, 197); its contract makes it a dummy aura (AscensionSunClericContracts.cpp:116-120). AscensionSunCleric::Refresh, run every 500 ms from sun_cleric_player::OnPlayerUpdate, checks it (AscensionSunCleric.cpp:356-363): while the buff is up and Sunflare 800231 is known it teaches Sun Ray 504764 with learnSpell(504764, true), a temporary spell never written to character_spell, and registers it over every known Sunflare rank with Player::SetTemporarySpellReplacement. Before the fix Player::_SaveActions wrote 504764 for a button holding Sun Ray, and Player::_LoadActions at the next login runs before Refresh teaches it again, so the button was refused and deleted. The fixture applies 803238 directly instead of rolling the proc. persisted_action_button reads Player::GetSavedActionButtonSpell, the id _SaveActions writes. A button holding Sun Ray must be saved as Sunflare; a button holding Sunflare is saved unchanged.

steps.label: The buff replaces Sunflare with Sun Ray
The Sun Ray button is saved as Sunflare
Control: an ordinary known spell is saved unchanged
